title: Nonlinear Schrödinger equation in an exterior domain
description: Research article: Nonlinear Schrödinger equation in an exterior domain
summary: The authors study the exact controllability of the cubic nonlinear Schr¨odinger equation in the exterior Ω= Rn \ Θ of a non-trapping obstacle Θ, with internal controls supported outside a large ball, and the corresponding boundary control problem on Ω0 = BR0 \ Θ with Dirichlet controls acting only on the outer sphere ∂BR0. Using the local smoothing effect of Burq, G´erard and Tzvetkov, the authors prove observability inequalities for the linear Schr¨odinger equation in the whole scale of Sobolev spaces HσD(Ω), σ ∈[−2, 2], associated with the Dirichlet Laplacian; they require only the non-trapping assumption (no star-shapedness of Θ), and their proofs use no normal boundary traces. Combined with Strichartz-type estimates and a perturbation argument, this yields local exact controllability in H10(Ω) and in H2(Ω)∩H10(Ω), in dimensions two and three, around the zero solution and, for internal controls and under a unique continuation assumption, around nontrivial2026 trajectories.
The same method applies to the quintic equation, which is energy-critical in dimension Oct three. Several open problems are discussed. 13 1.
